Name: SCRATCHED_PARTS_PARAM_ST
Description: Handles Ironeye's Marking, such as damage and animations of characters

Fields.Name: Character ID
Fields.Description: Character (model number, c0000 = player) whose parts this row defines; rows are grouped per character by Part Index.

Fields.Name: Part Index
Fields.Description: Which of the character's breakable parts (0-6) this row defines. A character can have up to 7 rows, one per index; 7 or more: the row is ignored. Retail: 0 except 1 on row 2.

Fields.Name: Break Damage (% of Max HP)
Fields.Description: When the marked part's damage threshold is used up, the character takes this % of its max HP as extra damage. Read as 0-255. Retail: 5-30.

Fields.Name: Break Threshold (% of Max HP)
Fields.Description: Damage to the marked part needed to break it, as % of the character's max HP. Only the low byte is used (0-255). Retail: 20 or 30 (10 on two test rows).

Fields.Name: Damage Taken Rate
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier on hits to the marked part. Retail: 1.1 (2 on two test rows).

Fields.Name: Break Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the character plays when the marked part breaks. Retail: 8700 on most characters, 8060 on some large ones.

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly Id
Fields.Description: Dummy poly of the part that the marking attaches to; hits are matched to the part by it. Retail: 220.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Stored with the part's state next to Dummy Poly ID; no use found. Retail: -1 on every row.
